A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.28; also called Ilai at 1Ch.11.29; 
Another name of tsal.mon (צַלְמוֹן "Zalmon" H6756B) 
§ Ilai = "exalted"
an Ahohite, one of David's mighty warriors
